listing.name: Colony Threats Tweaks (1.0.3)
listing.summary: Provides in-game sliders to tweak hostile activity settings like progress multipliers, fleet caps, and tithes.
listing.aiSummary: Provides in-game sliders to tweak hostile activity settings like progress multipliers, fleet caps, and tithes.

description:
Colony Threats Tweaks

Downloads

Requires

LunaLib

Description

Settings for hostile activity. Tweak pathers, pirates, hegemony, and the rest.

-In-game sliders for the HA settings(progress mults, fleet caps, tithe, kanta, ai-core points)

-Vanilla defaults, so it does nothing until you change something.

-Utility mod. Add or remove mid-save; current HA score is kept, only future gain changes.

This is my first mod so hopefully everything is correct. I think I've found most of the keys that relate to HA. If there is something else let me know please!
